You can activate once and only once the same effect as the (When Summoned) effect of the Spirit/Brave that caused the activation of this Burst, treating as activated by your Spirit. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, the targeted Spirit can't attack/block.
